version_name: Review fixes: reports, ISA integrity, CLD sync, JSON round trips, deploy/CI hygiene

critical: Reports render through a static template and never knit user text (N11); reports are served per session, not from the shared www/reports (N14) - PR #63.
CLD edits keep ISA element IDs, names, full cell values and user-edited flags (N3) - PR #65.
JSON round trips (local storage, .json load, language switch) keep matrices and element tables intact (N4) - PR #70.
Graphical SES Export to ISA works and writes the canonical schema (N6) - PR #69.
Boolean attractor search enforces its node cap; Limits-to-Growth aggregated per Response (N16, N17) - PR #68.
high: ISA: removing an element prunes its matrices; CLD edits reach the event bus; matrix selector keys; import guard; R-arm recovery (N5, N22, N38, N49, N50) - PR #64.
Deploys preserve the feedback log and a writable data/, touch restart.txt; CI fails zero-pass test files; root scripts stay app-scoped; export-ignore (N8, N42, N43, N44, N80) - PR #66.
Bookmark restore validates URL values (N81, N82) - PR #67.
User-level settings are per session (N20) - PR #71.
